title: 第一卷 第2章 他的刀不够快，更不够狠！
novel_title: 开局自曝系统，家族助我娶妻成仙！
content_zh:
林清雅！

    姜无痕对她有点印象，是林家旁支的庶女，因长相出众，平日里没少被林晶晶的针对。

    这次，她更是被当做陪嫁丫鬟送了过来。

    一身红衣，在人群中格外显眼。

    姜无痕刚才的话，虽然声音不大，却如同五雷轰顶，让林家众人愣在原地。

    “逆女，你怎敢如此不知廉耻，私下与陆家奸贼苟合，做出这种败坏门风的事！”林家老祖林苍天咬牙切齿，厉声怒斥，“你这么做，对得起家族，对得起帝子吗？”

    林晶晶脸色难看，擦去嘴角的血迹，沉声道：“我就是不喜欢姜无痕这种不求上进的废物，我有什么错？”

    “还有，你有什么资格指责我，你生了我爷爷，不代表你就是我老祖。抛开血缘关系不谈，你对我来说，也只是个毫无关系的糟老头子！”

    这几年，她被姜无痕高高捧起，就连林苍天都不放在眼里。

    她看向姜无痕，冷声道：“姜无痕，我念你这些年的付出，原本还想着……即便与陆哥哥在一起，也会给你一个追求我的机会。但现在，你我恩断义绝！”

    “无论你找来怎样的天材地宝，为我重塑修为，我都不会再原谅你……”

    林晶晶贝齿紧咬，仿佛她才是那个遭到了背叛的人。

    “煞笔！”

    姜无痕冷哼，连看都没看一眼，走向林家众人。

    林苍天神情惶恐，连忙祈求道：“帝子息怒，林家愿奉上一切，向帝子道歉，只求能给林家留一线生机……”

    他仿佛看到，九族在天上失禁的看着他！

    然而，姜无痕并未在意他的话，径直走向林清雅。

    这位红衣少女缩在角落，仿佛预见了林家灭门的下场，面如死灰。

    直到——

    “你愿不愿……做我的帝子妃？”

    姜无痕的声音响起，林清雅缓缓抬头，左右看了看，美眸中浮现出了一抹疑惑。

    “帝子，您是在跟我说话？”

    林清雅微微蹙眉，怯生生的问道。

    “就是你！”姜无痕点头，坦言道，“你若嫁给我，不仅能保住林家，之前赠予林家的资源和聘礼，也无需退还。”

    这一刻，林家众人期许的目光，纷纷落在了林清雅的身上。

    林清雅望着姜无痕，脑海中思绪万千。

    诚然，姜无痕非良人，但她只是毫无地位的陪嫁丫鬟。

    如今，家族兴灭又全在她一念之间。

    林清雅根本没有选择的余地！

    “我愿意！”林清雅眉头舒展，脸上强颜欢笑，“能侍奉帝子，是我的荣幸！”

    姜无痕点点头，嘴角勾起一抹笑意：“很好，去换衣服，准备拜堂成亲吧！”

    说完，他走向帝子殿，只留下目瞪口呆的众人。

    “无痕他究竟在做什么？放着追求了三年的林家嫡女不娶，反倒要娶一个陪嫁丫鬟？”

    一位姜家族老疑惑道。

    姜家家主姜临天望着姜无痕的背影，目光深邃，淡然道：“对于姜家而言，林家的嫡女和庶女……没什么区别，都是蝼蚁罢了。只要无痕喜欢，就算他想娶不朽皇朝的皇女，我等也应当满足他！”

    言语间，他忍不住轻叹一声，道：“大帝与帝后镇守生命禁区，无痕作为他们唯一的血脉，自襁褓中托付我等。可我们却无法将他培育成才，愧对大帝和帝后……”

    一众姜家族老闻言，不约而同的叹了口气，眼里满是愧疚。
content_en:
Lin Qingya!

Jiang Wuhen had some impression of her. She was a concubine from a branch of the Lin family. Because of her outstanding appearance, she was often targeted by Lin Jingjing.

This time, she was sent as a dowry maid.

Dressed in red, he stood out among the crowd.

Although Jiang Wuhen's words just now were not loud, they were like thunder, making everyone in the Lin family freeze on the spot.

"Rebellious girl, how dare you be so shameless, secretly liaise with Lu family traitors, and do such a thing that ruins the family tradition!" Lin Cangtian, the ancestor of the Lin family, gritted his teeth and shouted angrily, "Are you worthy of the family and the emperor's son by doing this?"

Lin Jingjing's face turned ugly. She wiped the blood from the corner of her mouth and said solemnly: "I just don't like Jiang Wuhen, a waste who doesn't seek to make progress. What's wrong with me?"

"Also, what qualifications do you have to accuse me? Just because you gave birth to my grandfather does not mean that you are my ancestor. Putting aside the blood relationship, to me, you are just a bad old man who has nothing to do with you!"

In the past few years, she had been held in high esteem by Jiang Wuhen, and even Lin Cangtian looked down upon her.

She looked at Jiang Wuhen and said coldly: "Jiang Wuhen, I miss your efforts over the years. I originally thought that... even if you are with Brother Lu, you will be given a chance to pursue me. But now, we are completely sworn in!"

"No matter what kind of treasures you find to rebuild my cultivation for me, I will never forgive you again..."

Lin Jingjing gritted her teeth, as if she was the one who had been betrayed.

"Shabi!"

Jiang Wuhen snorted coldly and walked towards the Lin family without even looking at them.

Lin Cangtian looked horrified and quickly prayed: "The Emperor is angry, the Lin family is willing to sacrifice everything and apologize to the Emperor, just to leave a chance for the Lin family..."

He seemed to see the nine tribes looking at him incontinently in the sky!

However, Jiang Wuhen didn't pay attention to his words and walked straight towards Lin Qingya.

The girl in red cowered in the corner, as if she had foreseen the fate of the Lin family being wiped out, her face turned ashen.

Until——

"Are you willing... to be my imperial concubine?"

Jiang Wuhen's voice sounded, and Lin Qingya slowly raised her head, looked around, and a trace of doubt appeared in her beautiful eyes.

"Emperor, are you talking to me?"

Lin Qingya frowned slightly and asked timidly.

"That's you!" Jiang Wuhen nodded and said frankly, "If you marry me, not only will you be able to keep the Lin family, but the resources and betrothal gifts previously given to the Lin family will not need to be returned."

At this moment, the expectant eyes of everyone in the Lin family fell on Lin Qingya.

Lin Qingya looked at Jiang Wuhen, with thousands of thoughts in her mind.

It is true that Jiang Wuhen is not a husband, but she is just a dowry maid with no status.

Now, the rise and fall of the family all depends on her thoughts.

Lin Qingya had no choice at all!

"I do!" Lin Qingya frowned and forced a smile on her face, "It is my honor to serve the emperor!"

Jiang Wuhen nodded, with a smile on his lips: "Very good, let's go change and get ready to get married!"

After saying that, he walked towards the Emperor's Palace, leaving only the stunned people.

"What on earth is Wuhen doing? Instead of marrying the legitimate daughter of the Lin family who he has been pursuing for three years, he wants to marry a dowry maid instead?"

An elder from the Jiang family asked doubtfully.

Jiang Lintian, the head of the Jiang family, looked at Jiang Wuhen's back with deep eyes and said calmly: "As far as the Jiang family is concerned, there is no difference between the legitimate daughters and the concubines of the Lin family. They are all just ants. As long as Wuhen likes it, even if he wants to marry the princess of the Immortal Dynasty, we should satisfy him!"

As he spoke, he couldn't help but sigh softly and said: "The Emperor and the Empress guard the restricted area of life. As their only bloodline, Wuhen was entrusted to us since his infancy. But we were unable to cultivate him into a talent. We are ashamed of the Emperor and the Empress..."

After hearing this, all the elders of the Jiang family sighed in unison, their eyes full of guilt.
